The '''Otoh Villages''' was the name given to the many discrete [[Hydrostatic bubble/Legends|hydrostatic bubble]] used for residences located in the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Description==
The Otoh Villages were the residential areas of the lake city of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]]. Each village bubble was opaque and contained residential and commercial districts, as well as providing civic services. Radiating outwards from [[City Bigspace/Legends|City Bigspace]], the villages closest to the Bigspace were considered to upscale, while those farther afield were middle- to lower-class residences. .
